import json, rasterio, numpy as np, geopandas as gpd
from rasterio.mask import mask

# Load layers
taluks = gpd.read_file('dataset/taluks.gpkg')
vv = rasterio.open('dataset/s1_vv_20180821_db.tif')
perm_water = gpd.read_file('dataset/flood_extent_20180821.gpkg')

# Select Kuttanad
kuttanad = taluks[taluks['name'].str.lower()=='kuttanad'].to_crs(vv.crs)

# Clip VV to Kuttanad
vv_clip, vv_transform = mask(vv, kuttanad.geometry, crop=True)
vv_data = vv_clip[0]

# Mask permanent water
perm_water = perm_water.to_crs(vv.crs)
perm_mask, _ = mask(vv, perm_water.geometry, crop=True)
perm_mask = perm_mask[0]

# Threshold for flooding
water_threshold_vv_db = -20
flooded = (vv_data < water_threshold_vv_db) & (~np.isnan(vv_data)) & (~np.isnan(perm_mask))

# Compute areas
pixel_area = vv.res[0] * vv.res[1]  # 30x30 = 900 m2
flooded_area_m2 = flooded.sum() * pixel_area
kuttanad_area_m2 = kuttanad.geometry.area.iloc[0]
